title: campanula rapunculoides var. trachelioides
intro: Campanula rapunculoides var. trachelioides, commonly known as Trachelium or False Thimbleflower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Trachelium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Trachelium include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and exhibiting antioxidant activity, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
